checks.q: Is the off-chain asset attestation properly verified on-chain?
Are compliance requirements (KYC/AML) enforced in token transfers?
Is the redemption mechanism guaranteed against issuer default?
Are interest/yield distributions from underlying assets correctly calculated?
Is the token supply correctly pegged to verified underlying assets?
Are transfer restrictions properly implemented for regulatory compliance?
Is the oracle for off-chain asset valuation reliable and timely?
Are maturity dates and coupon payments handled correctly for debt instruments?
Is the token compatible with DeFi protocols while maintaining compliance?
Are forced transfer/freeze mechanisms limited to authorized regulators?
